label: Rock in Rio 2026 — 12/09 (sáb) · Gramado
_note_supply: Officially sold out at the box office when observed 2026-09-01; the resale market was NOT empty -- 207 Gramado Inteira listed, cheapest Gramado R$ 528,00.
_note_face_value: Gramado face value (Juan, 2026-09-01): Inteira R$ 870,00 / Meia R$ 435,00. Because the gate does not check class, R$ 435,00 is the effective benchmark for the cheapest usable ticket -- anything above it is a resale premium. Documentation only: no rule reads this field.
_note_filters: Gramado only (Juan's call 2026-09-01). entry_class is deliberately unfiltered: Rock in Rio does not check ticket type at the gate, so any class is usable and the cheapest one wins. Set extra.sector to null to watch all 6 sectors.
_note_rules: ONLY lowest_ever is enabled (Juan, 2026-09-01), matching the other targets: notify when the price drops below the lowest ever recorded, and nothing else. Each successive new low fires again because the record moves down with it. below_threshold is configured at the R$ 435,00 meia face value but DISABLED -- arming it would be dormant on any night already trading under face, which is the exact trap re-baselined away in v1.1. Flip `enabled` only after checking the night is above it.
